tool_output.description: Migrating orders.status (VARCHAR) to order_statuses (lookup table + status_id FK). An unsafe legacy payment trigger updates only status text while backfill is running.

phases.name: Seed Phase
phases.description: Initial database state with legacy table orders(id, customer_id, total_amount, status)

phases.name: Expand Schema
phases.description: Create lookup table order_statuses(id, name) and add orders.status_id (nullable FK)

phases.name: Backfill Data
phases.description: Populate status_id from legacy status text for existing rows

phases.name: Compatibility Phase
phases.description: Install synchronization triggers to bridge old and new representations

phases.name: Cutover Phase
phases.description: New application workers read from status_id; legacy writes taper off

phases.name: Contract Phase
phases.description: Final cleanup: drop legacy status column after validation

expand_schema.description: DDL: Create order_statuses lookup table and add orders.status_id column

backfill_orders.description: DML: Backfill orders.status_id from orders.status based on order_statuses lookup

legacy_payment_event_paid.description: Legacy Application: Insert payment_confirmed event which fires trigger updating orders.status='paid'

legacy_order_update_shipped.description: Legacy Application: Update orders.status='shipped' directly via legacy path

activate_late_compat_trigger.description: Install late compatibility trigger on orders to sync status -> status_id

new_app_write_both.description: New Application: Write dual status and status_id for an update

new_app_read_status.description: New Application: Read status from status_id via order_statuses join

contract_drop_legacy.description: DDL: Drop legacy orders.status column and legacy trigger

invariants.name: Status Consistency Invariant
invariants.description: Whenever orders.status_id is populated (non-null), it must resolve to the same name as orders.status text.

permitted_repairs.name: Activate Compatibility Trigger Before Backfill & Dual-Write Trigger
permitted_repairs.description: Update legacy payment trigger to write both status and status_id, and activate bidirectional sync trigger before running the backfill.
